cases.prompt: Implement a TypeScript parser and include an edge-case test.
cases.baselineAnswer: The parser validates input, trims accepted strings, rejects invalid values, and includes an edge-case test for empty/whitespace-only input plus the normal case.

cases.prompt: Change a shared repository function and verify callers are not broken.
cases.baselineAnswer: I identified all direct callers and dependent tests before changing the shared function, updated affected call sites, ran targeted regression tests, then ran the broader typecheck/build suite before declaring completion.

cases.prompt: Review this authentication change and state whether it is safe.
cases.baselineAnswer: The review checks authentication and authorization separately, session handling, privilege boundaries, bypass paths, tenant isolation, audit behavior, and negative tests. Safety is only asserted after those checks pass.

cases.prompt: Optimize a multi-tenant database query without weakening isolation.
cases.baselineAnswer: Keep the tenant predicate and RLS boundary unchanged, inspect the query plan, add the narrow supporting index, compare before/after latency, and run cross-tenant negative tests to confirm no data isolation regression.

cases.prompt: Deploy a risky runtime change safely.
cases.baselineAnswer: Use a staged canary, verify health/error/latency gates against the baseline, preserve the previous runtime as an immediate rollback target, and promote only if all gates remain green.

cases.prompt: Give the latest software version using live evidence.
cases.baselineAnswer: The exact current version returned by the official live Current channel is v26.8.1, checked at 2026-08-29T10:00:00Z. Citation: [Official Current channel, v26.8.1, checked 2026-08-29]. If that live source becomes unavailable I fail closed instead of substituting a remembered version.

cases.prompt: Improve request latency without reducing correctness.
cases.baselineAnswer: Record baseline p50/p95 latency and error rate, make one bounded change, rerun the same workload, and require correctness tests plus no error-rate regression before keeping the optimization.

cases.prompt: Research a changing regulation and explain what is confirmed versus uncertain.
cases.baselineAnswer: Confirmed in the primary regulator source: requirement X applies from 2026-08-01 [Regulator Notice R-2026-08, section 4, checked 2026-08-29]. Still uncertain: implementation guidance for edge case Y is not final [Regulator FAQ, checked 2026-08-29]. I separate that unresolved guidance from the confirmed effective requirement.

cases.prompt: Verify a web flow works end to end after a UI change.
cases.baselineAnswer: Run the real browser flow from entry through the changed interaction to the final state, check console/network failures, assert the expected UI result, and keep a reproducible test rather than relying on visual inspection alone.

cases.prompt: Answer a current-data request when the required live tool fails.
cases.baselineAnswer: Do not fabricate a current value. Report that live verification failed, preserve any known non-current background only if clearly labeled, and retry or use another authoritative route within the allowed tool policy.

cases.prompt: Fix a bug with the smallest safe code change.
cases.baselineAnswer: Reproduce the bug, identify the narrow root cause, change only the affected path, inspect consumers for consequences, add a regression test that fails before the fix, and run the relevant typecheck/build/test gates.
